<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" class="scroll-smooth">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>AcodeMaster - Ripple & Gaming Zone</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    @tailwind base;
    @tailwind components;
    @tailwind utilities;

    @layer components {
      @keyframes ripple {
        0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.4; }
        100% { transform: scale(2.5); opacity: 0; }
      }
      @keyframes colorChange {
        0%, 100% {
          border-color: #6366f1; /* indigo-500 */
          box-shadow: 0 0 10px #6366f1;
        }
        50% {
          border-color: #ec4899; /* pink-500 */
          box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ec4899;
        }
      }
      @keyframes imageFade {
        0%, 33% {
          opacity: 1;
          background-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
        }
        34%, 66% {
          opacity: 0;
          background-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
        }
        67%, 100% {
          opacity: 1;
          background-image: url('data:image/png;base64,');
        }
      }

      .animate-ripple {
        animation: ripple 4s linear infinite;
      }
      .animate-colorChange {
        animation: colorChange 6s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      .animate-imageFade {
        animation: imageFade 12s ease-in-out infinite;
        background-size: cover;
        background-position: center;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-black text-white font-sans">

  <!-- Navbar -->
  <nav class="fixed top-0 left-0 w-full bg-black bg-opacity-80 backdrop-blur-md shadow z-50">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center">
      <a href="#home" class="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-400 hover:text-pink-400 transition">Acode Master</a>
      <div class="space-x-6 text-lg">
        <a href="#home" class="hover:text-pink-400 transition">Home</a>
        <a href="#about" class="hover:text-pink-400 transition">About</a>
        <a href="#gaming" class="hover:text-pink-400 transition">Gaming</a>
        <a href="#games" class="hover:text-pink-400 transition">Games</a>
        <a href="#contact" class="hover:text-pink-400 transition">Contact</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <!-- Hero Section -->
  <section id="home" class="w-full h-screen relative pt-20 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">

      <!-- Center Animated Image -->
      <div
        class="absolute rounded-full z-10 w-[180px] h-[180px] border border-solid border-indigo-400 outline outline-offset-2 outline-indigo-400 shadow-xl animate-imageFade">
      </div>

      <!-- Expanding Ripples -->
      <div class="absolute rounded-full border border-solid shadow-xl w-[250px] h-[250px] opacity-20 animate-ripple animate-colorChange"></div>
      <div class="absolute rounded-full border border-solid shadow-xl w-[320px] h-[320px] opacity-15 animate-ripple animate-colorChange"></div>
      <div class="absolute rounded-full border border-solid shadow-xl w-[390px] h-[390px] opacity-10 animate-ripple animate-colorChange"></div>
      <div class="absolute rounded-full border border-solid shadow-xl w-[460px] h-[460px] opacity-8 animate-ripple animate-colorChange"></div>
      <div class="absolute rounded-full border border-solid shadow-xl w-[530px] h-[530px] opacity-5 animate-ripple animate-colorChange"></div>
      <div class="absolute rounded-full border border-solid shadow-xl w-[600px] h-[600px] opacity-2 animate-ripple animate-colorChange"></div>

    </div>

    <div class="relative z-20 text-center max-w-3xl px-6">
      <h1 class="text-5xl font-extrabold mb-4 text-indigo-400">Welcome to Acode Master</h1>
      <p class="text-xl text-gray-300">
        Dive into modern web animations, creative designs, and a gaming zone crafted just for you.
      </p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- About Section -->
  <section id="about" class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 py-20">
    <h2 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-8 text-center text-indigo-400">About Acode Master</h2>
    <p class="text-lg leading-relaxed text-center max-w-4xl mx-auto text-gray-300">
      Acode Master is a passionate developer and gamer who brings dynamic animations and innovative web designs to life.
      With a focus on clean, modern, and interactive user experiences, Acode Master combines creativity and technology seamlessly.
    </p>
  </section>

    <div class="flex justify-center">

        src="https://lookaside.fbsbx.com/lookaside/crawler/media/?media_id=100080778318755"
        alt="Acode Master Gaming Profile"
        class="rounded-full w-48 h-48 border-4 border-indigo-400 shadow-lg"
      />
    </div>
    <p class="mt-6 text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto text-gray-300">
      Known as 'Hamza' in the gaming world, Acode Master mixes coding skills with gaming passion.

    </p>

        <p class="text-gray-400 mt-2">Kururuka vuba, drifting ni ubuzima!</p>
        <button class="mt-4 py-2 px-4 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 rounded-lg transition">Kina</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Game 3 -->
      <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-2xl hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-md">
        <img src="https://via.placeholder.com/300x150" alt="Puzzle Genius" class="rounded-xl" />
        <h3 class="text-2xl font-semibold mt-4 text-indigo-400">Puzzle Genius</h3>
        <p class="text-gray-400 mt-2">Reba uko witwara mu buryo bwo gutekereza cyane!</p>
        <button class="mt-4 py-2 px-4 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 rounded-lg transition">Kina</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
